Task 103 threads these existing facts through public projection entrypoints instead of adding a parallel selected-weapon or eligibility cache.

Accepted reselection updates existing CharacterBuild selected-class-choice refs through completeLongRest; Weapon Mastery reselection failures expose a projection-choice hole without storing rejection state; unrelated completeLongRest failures return route=none with empty qRoute.
